privacy_boundary: Text scene direction and locally derived textual lighting profile only. No camera pixels, stills, audio, video, credentials, or user identifiers.

scenes.text: Uncluttered warm home office with a clear central subject zone and no people, text, marks, or logos.
Neutral modern studio/library with the same central subject zone and exclusions.

lighting_profiles.text: Soft warm key from camera-left (~3200 K), low contrast, gentle fill, rear wall about one stop darker.
Cooler hard key from camera-right (~5600 K), higher contrast, weak fill, plausible directional shadows and depth falloff.

prompt_template: Create a photorealistic empty background for a solo-camera recording. Scene: {{scene}} Lighting to match: {{lighting}} Preserve a clear central zone for the genuine camera subject. Make lighting direction, color temperature, contrast, room depth, depth-of-field, and plausible environmental shadows mutually consistent. Do not include any person, body part, text, mark, logo, watermark, camera interface, or composited foreground subject.
